question: After the failed topology/dependency checks are explained or fixed, should this PR become the canonical cross-channel delivery-owner refactor?
rationale: This is a protected, multi-channel queue-state refactor whose correctness depends on an owner-boundary decision and recovery semantics that cannot safely be inferred from check status alone.

options.title: Review after gates are resolved

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Keep the current separate paths until maintainers want to take ownership of the cross-channel queue-state consolidation and its recovery invariants.
